searchText: Hey folks, I just finished writing up a proposal for a new discv5 packet format. https://github.com/ethereum/devp2p/issues/152 This proposal is supposed to address the WHOAREYOU type confusion issue (https://github.com/ethereum/devp2p/issues/131) Please check it out! Thanks <@!194432762315407360>! I'd be interested to hear what you guys think about the DPI resistance thing. Not sure if it's really worth the added complexity. cc: <@!498009160982724610> <@!425907307621122049> <@!476250636548308992> <@!449019668296892420> <@!539495253418180618> I guess SSZ would not be for discussion, if the packet format is changing already? You can actually parse most of the packet with SSZ now :) I didn't want to change the message content, so that's still RLP. The part that isn't SSZ-compatible is the variable-size part of the handshake We can try to make that compatible if everyone wants it
